[{"insert":"1 1/4 Goblet Cyclist Squat

The 1 1/4 goblet cyclist squat adds a quarter rep at the bottom of each squat, and the raised heels keep the work on your quads. Come all the way down, up a quarter, back down, then stand tall. That extra quarter piles up time in the hardest position without needing heavy weight. Pair it with the single leg RDL, where the hand support is only for balance, so your working leg still does all the lifting.
"}]
